// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// The shape the gate exists to require.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { likeSafe } from "@/lib/likeSafe";

export async function searchSchools(query: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({
    where: {
      OR: [
        { name: { startsWith: likeSafe(query) } },
        { name: { contains: ` ${likeSafe(query)}` } },
      ],
    },
  });
}
